messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Pool 'pool-helios-dedicated' GPU exhaustion detected. Tenant 'helios-fin-prod' holding all GPUs > 10m. Threshold breach: 98%. Severity P1 - paging oncall.
pagerduty: paging lee-oncall (primary)

lee-oncall: acked. pulling metrics and runbook now. Which pool is this?

anika-sre: it's the dedicated-fin pool in eu-west-1 (alias pool-helios-dedicated). 6x A100s. All 6 at 99%. Only tenant allocated: helios-fin-prod (reserved).
omar-infra: quick inventory: pool is strict reserved (autoscale: disabled), customer did not opt-into burst. We have 3 spare GPUs in region shared pool but billing flag required for burst to reserved pools.

lee-oncall: any customer-side jobs? tag CSE.
tara-csm: pinging customer SREs and CSEs: "we see high GPU usage, impacting your dedicated pool; any scheduled jobs?"

devops-bot: Recent events: model deploy on helios-fin-prod at 06:10 UTC; multiple retrain/batch jobs kicked off 06:22 UTC.

omar-infra: I can see long-lived batch workers: job ids: hb-backfill-51, hb-backfill-52. They are batched RLHF-style jobs that run until completion.
anika-sre: impact: prod inference endpoints in that pool are rate-limited now; errors 429 creeping up. Customer-facing alert likely.

lee-oncall: options per runbook (short): A) emergency burst from shared (requires customer approval for billing), B) kill/evict low-priority batch runs (we can, but will anger SRE), C) route inference traffic to hosted models (translation required), D) ask customer to pause backfills. Need rapid decision - what's fastest?
omear-infra: fastest is enable burst +1 or +2 GPUs from shared, applied immediately. Routing to hosted requires model compatibility check and tokenization mapping, ~10-20m. Eviction is immediate but harsh.

tara-csm: customer response: "We have a nightly reconcile that started accidentally. Please avoid killing anything; we can pause if you enable a short burst." They asked for prod to remain live.

lee-oncall: tara, confirm they accept billing for short burst?
tara-csm: they approved short burst for 90 minutes and asked for cost estimate.

lee-oncall: executing emergency burst for +2 GPUs for 5400s (90m). Running command:
```
# request burst from shared pool
platformctl pool burst --pool pool-helios-dedicated --add 2 --duration 5400 --initiator lee-oncall --reason "mitigate accidental backfill, keep prod live"
```

incident-bot: ACTION: burst request submitted. br-hel-202603-99. Awaiting allocation.

cody-capacity: allocation successful: +2 GPUs applied. pool now 8 GPUs total, 2 available. Utilization drops to 75% in ~30s.
anika-sre: monitoring latency metrics... p50/p95 restored to normal for prod endpoints. Batch jobs still running but queued concurrency reduced.

lee-oncall: add temp quota so batch jobs can't steal all GPUs again. Suggest max_concurrent_batches: 2 for helios-fin-prod.
omar-infra: applying quota now:
```
platformctl quota set --tenant helios-fin-prod --key max_concurrent_batches --value 2 --scope pool:pool-helios-dedicated
```

devops-bot: Quota change applied (q-hel-442).

tara-csm: customer confirmed they paused the additional backfill jobs via their scheduler. Thanks team. Asking for summary to share with execs.

lee-oncall: handing to anika for 60m watch and post-incident writeup. I'll clear page.
anika-sre: taking over. Immediate mitigation success confirmed. Recommended follow-ups: 1) change default for reserved pools to explicit opt-in for burst with billing auto-approval for emergency (billing notified), 2) update onboarding docs to warn customers about overnight batch runs in reserved pools, 3) build alert that detects single-tenant sustained >90% for >5m and auto-notify CSM/CSE.

omar-infra: also propose a small feature: allow customers to set a "burst burn" budget that allows N seconds of burst without manual billing approval. I'll open RFC.

cody-capacity: provisional billing entry created and flagged to finance; will send estimate to tara for customer.

anika-sre: status @ +45m: pool stable, quota holding, no errors. Marking incident mitigated and lowering severity to P3 for follow-ups.

lee-oncall: closing active page. Put tasks on incident board: #autoscale-policy, #onboarding-notes, #burst-budget-rfc, #customer-postmortem. Tara, please coordinate summary for customer.
tara-csm: will do. Draft to customer will include timeline, mitigation steps, billing note, and recommended next steps.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated: pool-helios-dedicated utilization below threshold. Severity downgraded to P3.

anika-sre: I'll file a short RCA and link to support ticket later. Good work everyone. :clap:
